description.target: The target option in your tsconfig.json specifies the version of JavaScript that TypeScript will compile your code to. For example, "target": "es2015" tells TypeScript to generate JavaScript code compatible with ES2015 (also known as ES6).
description.importance: It determines which JavaScript features will be available in the output code. If you use newer TypeScript/JavaScript features, setting a higher target ensures they are supported in the generated code. For older browsers or environments, you may need to set a lower target (like "es5").
description.example: If you use arrow functions, classes, or let/const, you need at least "es2015" as your target.
